item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.3.0

  • Every note can have its own text size: pick it from the number beside the typeface in the formatting bar (the Aa button). A note you have not sized follows the size in Settings, as before, and its size syncs with the note
  • New notes start in the typeface and size you last picked in a note, instead of going back to Virgil each time. Choosing a font in Settings makes that the starting point again
  • The deck card's preview now shows a note in its own typeface, not the one from Settings
  • A title emoji no longer sits on a grey tint. The tint appears when you point at it, so it still reads as a button
